title: Template:GliderSkill
text: Used by Module:Glider for a glider skill that has an ID in Module:GliderSkillIds. Shows the skill name from the glider's description with a hover box. The hover box uses the skill's own name and icon from aa-classic.com (they can differ from the glider's text), plus mana, cast time, cooldown and effect. Not meant to be used on its own. Parameters: id (skill ID), name, color (RRGGBB, the colour of the name). Needs Module:Mount and Template:Mount/styles.css.
